description: Files a feature request for Tip & Overtime Deductions on Brick & Mortar's public request board (brickandmortar.dev/requests), where anyone can read and upvote it, and notifies the person who builds Tip & Overtime Deductions. For something Tip & Overtime Deductions does not do or hold yet: a state's rules, a pay situation or form it does not work out, a payroll export it cannot read. title is the person's own words, verbatim and short; detail is optional; contact is an email or handle exactly as they offered it, sent to the builder only and never shown on the board. ok true means it was filed.

contact.description: Optional: email or handle for a reply, verbatim, only if offered

detail.description: Optional: what they were trying to do

title.description: What they want, in their own words, ideally under 90 characters

name: request_a_feature
title: Request a Tip & Overtime Deductions feature
